source_observations: Pinned DFlash _forward_draft_blocks builds a fresh anchor-dependent attention mask; three inherited cache attributes are initialized None and otherwise unused in this source. General mutable BlockMask preservation is not claimed.
Every temporary candidate is constructed from the same saved actual post-K parameters; original full correction snapshot is always restored in finally.
A and D pre-K captures use the same qualified evaluation/RNG/anchor machinery as R, not ordinary training logits.
Final K_ONLY R replay compares native decisions, all canonical margins, prefix rows, pooled numerator/denominator and violation exactly against original post-K reference evidence.
Endpoint comparator uses native decoded tensor bytes, optimizer state, RNG, settings, ordinary records and counters, with metadata differences reported separately.
The original KRC2-only continuation constructor remains unchanged; additive event4-only wrapper admits KRC3 384/768 and full three-event history.
